title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30
source: Audience Source Tape: Reel dubbed in 1979 by Will Boswell (3 3/4ips) from Jerry Garcia's personal collection. Original recording made by the sound crew at the soundboard; Transfer info: Akai GX636 direct tape head output > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/ a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960 > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC

ai_review.summary: A magnificent 1973 audience recording that captures the hall ambience and is hailed as epitome of the year, though reviewers lament the flood of undocumented versions.
ai_review.review: The 24‑bit audience transfer from Jerry Garcia's personal reel is praised for its clear hall sound and faithful capture of a classic 1973 performance. While one reviewer celebrates the show as “the epitome of 1973,” others criticize the lack of documentation for the many uploaded versions, leading to mixed overall sentiment.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive comments on both performance and sound quality are balanced by low‑star complaints about versioning and documentation; limited specific musical detail reduces certainty.

recording_quality.technical_notes: 24‑bit audience transfer from a 1979 reel dub (Will Boswell) using Akai GX636, Telefunken tubes and Apogee gear; reviewers note excellent hall ambience but request clearer notes on differences between versions.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; overall impression is that the show represents a high point of the 1973 era.
